attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) dnsmasq via UCI to resolve app.internal -> node2's IP (10.100.101.11), pointed node3's resolver at node1 (persisted via dhcpcd static override), and started the previously-absent HTTP service on node2 (port 8080) since it was not actually running. Verified node3 resolves and reaches app.internal:8080 with no /etc/hosts entry. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery each time.
